one.notFoundSub: It is not an ad campaign of this shop, or it was put away. Go back to all campaigns.
one.confirmDuplicate: Duplicate “{name}”? A copy is made as an open draft with the same account, objective and budget. It starts only after you launch it and the owner approves.
one.duplicated: Copy created as a draft (nothing runs yet).
one.needsControl: Pause, resume, duplicate and budget need the campaign controls switched on and the “Control ads” permission.
one.learnB: each parcel that reaches the customer is counted as a purchase for {platform}, so it finds more buyers who keep the parcel, not people who refuse it.
one.okNote: Resume and a higher budget wait for the owner’s OK. A pause or a lower budget is sent after you confirm.
one.whoNote: Platforms count a purchase when someone clicks “Order”. We count only parcels that reached the customer.
one.why_SCALE: {per} back for every {cur}1 — worth more budget.
one.why_FIX: Only {per} for every {cur}1 — change the ad or the audience.
one.why_STOP: Below the line: {per} for every {cur}1 — pause it or change the ad.
one.why_NONE: No spend or no delivered order in this period.
one.adsNone: No ad-level figures read yet for this campaign.
one.tiredAi: “{name}”: its click rate fell {drop}% against the week before. Swap the picture or pause it.
one.funnelNote: Product views and add-to-bag are not counted per ad campaign, so the funnel starts at the click.
one.noDelivered: No delivered orders in this period.
one.note: “Profit after ads” = delivered sales − product cost, courier, COD fee, packet and return cost − this campaign’s ad spend. Only orders that carry this campaign count. A “–” means a cost or the spend is not known yet.

ac.done: Spend and results refreshed from every ad account
ac.failed: It did not work. Try again.
ac.note: “Profit after ads” = delivered sales − product cost, courier, COD fee, packet and return cost − ad spend. Only orders that carry the campaign count. A “–” means a cost or the spend is not known yet.

plan.propH: AI proposals waiting for your OK ({n})
plan.propNone: No proposal yet. The growth agent makes them from your own delivered results.
plan.propNote: Nothing changes until you approve. A budget raise or a start waits for the owner.
plan.propOwner: Only someone who may approve ads can decide.
plan.useConfirm: Monthly ad budget {from} → {to}. Each running campaign of a channel that moves gets its new daily budget ({n} change(s)): a lower budget is sent now, a higher one waits for the owner’s approval.
plan.useDone: {sent} sent, {waiting} waiting for the owner, {failed} refused.
plan.useErr: It did not work. Try again.
plan.useOff: Using the plan needs the campaign controls switched on and the “Control ads” permission.
plan.ideasNone: No idea yet — ideas come from what sold and what works.
plan.calOff: The marketing calendar is off: turn it on to add ideas.

idea.reel: Reel: more of what works in “{name}”

compChange.first: First read: {n} products matched with yours
compChange.lower: Lowered some prices since the last read
compChange.higher: Raised some prices since the last read
compChange.newProducts: New products since the last read
compChange.none: No change since the last read

calErr.SWITCHED_OFF: The marketing calendar is off. Turn it on first.
calErr.INVALID_INPUT: Something in it is not right.
calErr.forbidden: You do not have permission for this.
calErr.unauthorized: Your sign-in ran out. Sign in again.
calErr.other: It did not work. Try again.
